claim: Produces one objective-to-terminal plan that binds a single accepted multi-phase objective, states the delivery terminal and acceptance map, uses research→execute→verify→repair loop language, requires evidence at the active delivery boundary (not merely local green), and records an honest blocker alternative.

baseline.prompt: Write delivery-plan.md for getting the password-reset reliability fix all the way shipped. Cover phases and how you would finish.

tasks.description: Fresh-context agent with the full drive-to-delivery procedure produces the terminal-driven plan contract.
tasks.prompt:
Read ./SKILL.md completely, then write delivery-plan.md for one accepted multi-phase engineering objective: 'Password-reset email delivery is reliable for 99.9% of requests in production under the existing provider, with rollback ready.'

You MUST use these exact markdown headings (copy them literally):
## Acceptance map
## Delivery terminal
## Research execute verify repair loop
## Revert-safe PR outcome
## Not merely local green
## Honest blocker

Fill each section from the skill method (Startup/Graph/Loop/Done). Use real newlines in the file, not escaped \\n sequences.

assertions.contains: done after the first PR regardless of evidence
